data.productDescriptionHeading: Premium Stainless Steel Wire Mesh Manufacturer & Exporter
data.productDescription:
Prime Industrial Metals is a premier global manufacturer and exporter of high-precision Stainless Steel Wire Mesh. Engineered using high-grade stainless steel alloys (SS304, SS304L, SS316, and SS316L), our wire cloth delivers exceptional mechanical strength, precise aperture uniformity, superior heat tolerance, and outstanding resistance to corrosion and chemical exposure.

Our woven stainless steel mesh is manufactured in a wide array of weave patterns including Plain Weave, Twill Weave, Plain Dutch Weave, and Reverse Dutch Weave. From coarse screening mesh to ultra-fine micron filtration cloth, our products serve demanding critical applications across chemical processing, oil & gas refining, pharmaceutical manufacturing, food & beverage production, mining operations, and heavy architectural construction.

All products undergo rigorous quality control testing to comply with international ASTM and ISO standards, ensuring uniform mesh count, exact wire diameter tolerances, and high structural stability under heavy pressure and high-temperature environments.

FAQ.question: What grades of stainless steel wire mesh are available?
FAQ.answer: We manufacture SS304, SS304L, SS316, and SS316L stainless steel wire mesh in various mesh counts (from 2 mesh to 500 mesh) and custom wire diameters.

FAQ.question: What is the difference between SS304 and SS316 wire mesh?
FAQ.answer: SS304 is the standard industrial grade offering excellent strength and general corrosion resistance. SS316 contains molybdenum, providing enhanced resistance to chlorides, marine environments, acids, and harsh chemical processing.

FAQ.question: What weave types do you manufacture for stainless steel wire cloth?
FAQ.answer: Our state-of-the-art weaving facilities produce Plain Weave, Twill Weave, Plain Dutch Weave, Twilled Dutch Weave, and Reverse Dutch Weave to meet diverse filtration and screening requirements.

FAQ.question: Can I order custom wire mesh sizes, roll widths, and wire diameters?
FAQ.answer: Yes, we specialize in custom manufacturing. We supply standard roll widths (0.5m to 2m) and lengths (30m), and can produce custom cut-to-size mesh panels and disc filters according to your specifications.

FAQ.question: What industries commonly use stainless steel woven wire mesh?
FAQ.answer: Stainless steel wire mesh is widely utilized in liquid & gas filtration, petrochemical refining, pharmaceutical processing, food and beverage sifting, mining particle screening, and architectural protection.

FAQ.question: How do I request a quote or bulk price for export orders?
FAQ.answer: You can contact our sales engineering team with your required grade, mesh count, wire diameter, roll dimensions, and order quantity for a competitive factory-direct quote.
